recipe.recipe_name: Creamy Tomato Soup with Cheddar Toast and Fried Egg
instructions: Dice the fresh tomatoes. Heat 1 tbsp of olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat, add the tomatoes, and cook until soft and juicy (about 8 minutes).
Pour in the whole milk and lower the heat to simmer gently for 5 minutes. Stir in half of the cheddar cheese (75g) until fully melted into a creamy soup base, then season with salt and pepper.
Brush the bread slices with remaining olive oil and toast them in a skillet over medium heat. Top with the remaining cheddar cheese, cover the skillet, and let it melt.
In the same skillet, gently fry the eggs until the whites are set but yolks remain soft.
Ladle the creamy tomato soup into bowls, top each with a fried egg, and serve alongside the warm cheddar toast.
recipe.waste_reduction_notes: This recipe prioritizes Whole Milk (expiring 2026-09-22) and Tomatoes (expiring 2026-09-23) to prevent spoilage, while efficiently using available bread, cheddar, and eggs to craft a complete lunch.

recipe.recipe_name: Air Fryer Cheesy Chicken & Tomato Bread Strata
instructions: Dice 1 chicken breast into small bite-sized pieces and toss with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Preheat the air fryer to 380°F (190°C) and cook the diced chicken for 8 minutes until cooked through, then set aside.
Cut the 4 slices of bread into 1-inch cubes and dice the tomatoes.
In a mixing bowl, whisk together 4 eggs and 250 ml of whole milk until well combined.
Grease an air-fryer-safe baking dish or tin with a little olive oil. Layer in the bread cubes, cooked chicken, and diced tomatoes.
Pour the egg and milk mixture evenly over the bread and tomatoes, pressing down gently so the bread absorbs the liquid.
Shred and sprinkle 100g of cheddar cheese evenly over the top.
Place the dish into the air fryer basket and bake at 330°F (165°C) for 18 to 20 minutes, until the custard is set and the cheesy top is golden brown.
Let it rest for 5 minutes before serving hot.
recipe.waste_reduction_notes: This recipe directly uses items expiring soonest: Whole Milk (expiring Sept 22), Eggs (Sept 23), Tomatoes (Sept 23), and Cheddar Cheese (Sept 24). Combining them into a savory baked strata prevents these highly perishable dairy and produce items from going to waste.
